def analyze_regions(name, grid, out, h_l, v_l):
    print(f"\n{name}:")
    sh = len(grid)
    sw = len(grid[0])
    
    forbidden = {grid[0][0]}
    forbidden.update({grid[h][c] for h in h_l for c in range(sw)})
    
    for i in range(3):
        r_start = h_l[i-1]+1 if i>0 else 0
        r_end = h_l[i]-1 if i<2 else sh-1
        for j in range(3):
            c_start = v_l[j-1]+1 if j>0 else 0
            c_end = v_l[j]-1 if j<len(v_l) else sw-1
            
            # Get all cells in this region
            cells = []
            for r in range(r_start, r_end+1):
                for c in range(c_start, c_end+1):
                    cells.append((r, c, grid[r][c]))
            
            # Find special items
            specials = [(r,c,v) for r,c,v in cells if v not in forbidden]
            
            # Check corners
            corners = [
                (r_start, c_start),
                (r_start, c_end),
                (r_end, c_start),
                (r_end, c_end)
            ]
            specials_at_corners = [p for p,_,v in specials if p in corners]
            
            expected_one = out[i][j] == 1
            has_special = len(specials) > 0
            has_corner_special = len(specials_at_corners) > 0
            
            print(f"[{i},{j}] output_1={expected_one}, has_special={has_special}, has_corner_special={has_corner_special}")
